rag.text:
Test: TC-3714 — Feature area - Task - Attributes displaying and editing - Live sync - Editing task in restored box
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-66 Feature area - Task - Attributes displaying and editing
Labels: teamtree

Steps:
1. Navigate to Overview module of Root Box.
   Expected: Overview module loads and boxes are displayed.
2. Open the "View" dropdown menu and select "Show Archived boxes" option.
   Expected: Option is selected and archived Boxes are displayed in the Hierarchy.
3. Navigate to the Gantt module of the boxName.
   Data: boxName: TC-3714 Feature area - Task - Attributes displaying and editing - Live sync - Editing task in restored box
   Expected: Gantt module is displayed with 3 tasks:

- TC3714-1 Summary to change
- TC3714-2 Status TO DO to change
- TC3714-3 Status DONE to change
4. Click on key of taskName
   Data: taskName: Summary to change
   Expected: Jira issue view is opened
5. Change summary to newSummary and go back to Gantt
   Data: newSummary: Highway to hell
   Expected: No change is visible on Gantt
6. Click on key of taskName
   Data: taskName: Status TO DO to change
   Expected: Jira issue view is opened
7. Change status to newStatus and go back to Gantt
   Data: newStatus: IN PROGRESS
   Expected: No change is visible on Gantt
8. Click on key of taskName
   Data: taskName: Status DONE to change
   Expected: Jira issue view is opened
9. # Change status to newStatus and go back to Gantt
   Data: newStatus: TO DO
   Expected: No change is visible on Gantt
10. In new tab navigate to Overview module of Root Box in the Hierarchy mode and search for the boxName
   Data: TC-3714 Feature area - Task - Attributes displaying and editing - Live sync - Editing task in restored box
   Expected: Overview module loads and boxes are displayed.
11. Click on the wrench button of the boxName and click on Restore button
   Data: TC-3714 Feature area - Task - Attributes displaying and editing - Live sync - Editing task in restored box
   Expected: Box is restored
12. Navigate to the tab with Gantt module of the boxName (do not refresh page)
   Data: boxName: TC-3714 Feature area - Task - Attributes displaying and editing - Live sync - Editing task in restored box
   Expected: Gantt module is displayed with 3 tasks:

- TC3714-1 Highway to hell
- TC3714-2 Status TO DO to change in DONE status
- TC3714-3 Status DONE to change in TO DO status
